upsell.title: The Founding Member Annual Pass
upsell.body: 12 months of Puntr Pro for a once-off R299, instead of R1,188 on R99 a month. You save R889. Your 12 months start on launch day, 1 December 2026, and it does not renew automatically.
upsell.note: A prepaid membership, not an investment. Reserve one of 20 places and complete the R299 PayFast payment within 48 hours. Reservations close 31 December 2026.

drawRules.title: Three R500 OTT voucher draw: rules
items: Open to Founding Members with an active Puntr Pro entitlement, aged 18 or older.
To enter, make at least one Practice Mode pick and submit this survey with the draw box ticked. Both steps are needed. One entry per member.
Entries close at 23:59 SAST on 31 December 2026.
Three distinct winners are picked at random from all valid entries. The draw is recorded with a witness.
Each winner receives one R500 OTT voucher. There is no cash alternative and prizes cannot be transferred.
Winners are announced on puntr.co.za and our social channels by username and Founding number only.
We contact winners by email, or by phone if they supplied a number. If a winner cannot be reached, we may select a replacement.
Puntr team members and their immediate family cannot enter. T&Cs apply. Helpline 0800 006 008.
